description: Ask GrowSurf to verify the team bound to the API key or OAuth connection. Verification is required before a program can email participants. Calling this again while a request is pending does not create a duplicate. Returns the team with its updated `verificationStatus`. Requires `GROWSURF_API_KEY`; does not require `GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID`.
name: growsurf_request_team_verification

outputSchema.description: The team bound to the API key or OAuth connection.

verificationRequestedAt.description: When verification was last requested, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

verificationStatus.description: Team verification state. `VERIFIED` is required before a program can send participant emails.

title: Request Team Verification
